title: Write Playwright E2E test: preview and editor
description: Write Playwright E2E tests for the preview page and editor. Tests the visual editor — section reordering, palette changing, and content editing.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test file exists at tests/e2e/editor.spec.ts
Test prerequisite: a 'ready' prospect (created by generation test or fixture)
Tests cover: preview page renders all sections, editor loads with section list, palette change updates preview colors, headline edit updates preview text, auto-save triggers

steps.details: Navigate to /preview/[slug] of a ready prospect. Assert at least 3 section containers are visible. Take screenshot.
Navigate to /edit/[slug]. Note current primary color CSS variable. Click a different palette swatch. Assert the primary color CSS variable changed in the preview pane.
In editor, open section content drawer for hero. Change the headline. Close drawer. Assert new headline is visible in the preview pane. Wait for auto-save indicator.
Run `npm run test:e2e tests/e2e/editor.spec.ts`. Tests pass.
